source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
If you don't have maintenance records, figure out what inspection records are available and use those.
3. Examine any video/photos you can find.
4. Go to the scene and take photos.
5. Inspect either under or above the bridge.
   1. Underneath bridges are usually easier to examine.
   2. When examining bridges under deck;
      1. Start upstream and examine each section towards downstream.
      2. Watch out for columns and other obstructions that will force you to examine under the deck;
         1. Examine the deck on the way.
   3. Go a bit east to examine the deck and the structural steel.
   4. Stop and examine the support for the bridge (foundations and columns).
